what: Teacher-forced tau2 replay: agent requests logged from a native 27B tau2 run (telecom, retail) are answered again by each variant; tool_match = same next tool as the logged reply, full_match = same tool and arguments, first_tool_match = on each conversation's first tool call. telecom_err = the 42 requests where the protected short-tail run made its first invalid (user-side) tool call; there the reference is that invalid call and invalid_tool_rate is the share of replies calling a tool the agent does not own.
